name: Meta-Scientific Astrology

author.name: Ruslan Dzhansakov
author.description: Creator of the Meta-Scientific Astrology theoretical framework.

description: A proto-scientific theory integrating quantum mechanics, process philosophy, and astrology to describe reality as a two-layered process of probability collapse.
keywords: Astrology, Quantum Mechanics, Process Philosophy, Proto-Reality, Consensus-Reality, The Field

hasPart.name: The Field
hasPart.description: The single, dynamic, informational foundation of all existence. Not a physical field, but a philosophical category representing the unity and process-based nature of reality (being-as-becoming).

hasPart.name: Proto-Reality
hasPart.description: The level of pure potential of [The Field], where all outcomes exist as information in a probabilistic state (quantum superposition). Experienced directly through dreams and altered states of consciousness.

hasPart.name: Consensus-Reality
hasPart.description: The single, actual result of the continuous 'collapse' of potential into the one manifested world shared by observers. Corresponds to the waking state.

hasPart.name: Body-Spacesuit
hasPart.description: The physical body viewed as a specialized interface between non-local consciousness and the material world, tuned to specific frequencies of [The Field].

hasPart.name: Synchronism
hasPart.description: The principle that all systems in the Universe are instinctively synchronized with the fundamental rhythms of [The Field], analogous to musicians following a conductor.

hasPart.name: Resonant Imprint
hasPart.description: The unique configuration of a system's sensitivity to [The Field]'s rhythms, fixed at the moment of its activation (birth). Represented by the natal chart.

hasPart.name: Resonance
hasPart.description: The dynamic activation of an internal potential when a current pattern in [The Field] matches a pattern in the system's Resonant Imprint.
